epithet.ko: 노예 출신으로 생도맹그를 통일해 1801년 헌법으로 종신 총독이 된 아이티 혁명의 지도자
epithet.en: Former slave who united Saint-Domingue and became governor-general for life in 1801, the foremost leader of the Haitian Revolution

bio.ko: 1743년 생도맹그 브레다 농장에서 노예로 태어나 1770년대에 해방되어 노예를 부리는 소농장주가 되었다. 1791년 봉기 뒤 비아수의 비서·부관으로 가담했고, 1793년 스페인군에 들어갔다가 프랑스의 노예제 폐지 뒤인 1794년 5월 프랑스 편으로 돌아섰다. 1796년 부총독이 되었고 1797년 송토나를 추방했으며 1798년 메이틀랜드와 영국군 철수 조약을 맺었다. 남부 전쟁에서 리고를 꺾고 1801년 1월 산토도밍고를 점령한 뒤 7월 종신 총독과 노예제 폐지, 농장 강제노동을 담은 헌법을 공포했다. 1802년 르클레르에게 항복했다가 체포되어 프랑스로 추방되었고 1803년 4월 7일 주 요새에서 옥사했다.
bio.en: Born a slave on the Bréda plantation in 1743 and manumitted in the 1770s, he became a small planter who owned slaves. After the rising of 1791 he joined Biassou as secretary and lieutenant, entered Spanish service in 1793 and came over to the French in May 1794, after France had abolished slavery. Lieutenant governor in 1796, he expelled Sonthonax in 1797 and in 1798 signed the treaties with Maitland for the British withdrawal. He defeated Rigaud in the War of the South, occupied Santo Domingo in January 1801 and in July promulgated a constitution that made him governor-general for life, abolished slavery and bound cultivators to the plantations. He submitted to Leclerc in 1802, was arrested and deported, and died in the Fort de Joux on 7 April 1803.

He promulgated the Constitution on 7 July 1801, officially establishing his authority over the entire island of Hispaniola. It made him governor-general for life with near absolute powers and the possibility of choosing his successor.

bio.ko: 1758년 생도맹그 북부 코르미에 농장에서 노예로 태어나 감독까지 올랐고, 그를 산 자유 유색인의 성을 물려받았다. 1791년 봉기에 가담해 장프랑수아의 부관이 되었고, 1794년부터 투생 루베르튀르의 주요 부관으로 1799년 여단장에 올랐다. 1802년 크레타피에로에서 1,300명으로 20일간 포위를 버텼고, 르클레르에게 투항했다가 노예제 복원 움직임에 10월 페티옹과 함께 다시 봉기해 반란군을 이끌었다. 1803년 11월 베르티에르에서 로샹보를 꺾고 1804년 1월 1일 고나이브에서 독립을 선포했다. 남은 프랑스인 3,000~5,000명의 학살을 명령했고 10월 황제 자크 1세로 대관했으며, 농장 노동을 강제해 반감을 사 1806년 10월 17일 퐁루주에서 암살되었다.
bio.en: Born a slave in 1758 on the Cormier plantation in the north of Saint-Domingue, he rose to foreman and took the surname of the free man of colour who bought him. He joined the rising of 1791 as a lieutenant of Jean-François and from 1794 was Toussaint Louverture's chief lieutenant, brigadier general by 1799. In 1802 he held Crête-à-Pierrot with 1,300 men through a twenty-day siege, submitted to Leclerc, and when the French moved to restore slavery rose again with Pétion in October, becoming leader of the rebels. He defeated Rochambeau at Vertières in November 1803 and on 1 January 1804 at Gonaïves proclaimed independence. He ordered the massacre of the remaining French, 3,000 to 5,000 people, was crowned Emperor Jacques I in October 1804, enforced plantation labour and was assassinated at Pont-Rouge on 17 October 1806.

evidence.excerpt: Of Afro-Caribbean origin, Jean-Jacques Duclos was born into slavery on Cormier, a plantation near Grande-Riviere-du-Nord, Saint-Domingue.

evidence.excerpt: Working in the sugarcane fields as a laborer, Dessalines rose to the rank of commandeur, or foreman. He worked on Duclos's plantation until he was about 30 years old.

evidence.excerpt: He later took the surname Dessalines, after a free man of color who had purchased him.
Dessalines became a lieutenant in Papillon's army and followed him to Santo Domingo

evidence.claim: Toussaint's chief lieutenant, brigadier general by 1799
evidence.excerpt: Dessalines followed, becoming a chief lieutenant to Toussaint Louverture and rising to the rank of brigadier general by 1799.
Dessalines commanded many successful engagements, including the captures of Jacmel, Petit-Goâve, Miragoâne and Anse-à-Veau.

evidence.excerpt: During the 11 March 1802 battle, Dessalines and his 1,300 men defended a small fort against 18,000 attackers.

On 18 November 1803, black and mulatto forces under Dessalines and Pétion attacked the fort of Vertières, held by Rochambeau, near Cap-Français in the north. Rochambeau and his troops surrendered the next day.

evidence.claim: declared independence at Gonaïves on 1 January 1804
evidence.excerpt: On 1 January 1804, from the city of Gonaïves, Dessalines officially declared the former colony's independence and renamed it "Ayiti" after the indigenous Taíno name.
He ordered the 1804 Haitian massacre of the remaining  Coloniser French population in Haiti, killing between 3,000 and 5,000 people, and an exodus of thousands.
He was crowned Emperor Jacques I in a coronation ceremony on 6 October in the city of Le Cap (now Cap-Haïtien).
As Emperor, Dessalines enforced plantation labor to promote the economy and began an autocratic rule.

epithet.en: Revolutionary general who burned Cap-Français and held the north, then president of the State of Haiti and King Henry I

bio.ko: 1767년 영국령 카리브해(그레나다 또는 세인트키츠)에서 태어나 노예로 생도맹그 북부에 끌려왔다. 1791년 봉기 이후 투생 루베르튀르 휘하에서 싸워 카프프랑세 사령관이 되었고 1801년 여단장이 되었다. 1802년 2월 르클레르 원정군이 오자 명령대로 카프프랑세를 불태웠으나 4월 투항했고, 10월 다시 데살린 편에 섰다. 데살린 암살 뒤 1807년 2월 아이티국 대통령이 되었고 1811년 3월 왕국을 선포해 앙리 1세로 즉위했다. 시타델 라페리에르와 상수시 궁전을 세우고 코르베 강제노동으로 설탕 수입을 올렸으나 민심을 잃었고, 1820년 10월 8일 병든 몸으로 반란을 두려워해 자살했다.
bio.en: Born in 1767 in the British Caribbean, in Grenada or perhaps Saint Kitts, he was brought as a slave to the north of Saint-Domingue. From the rising of 1791 he fought under Toussaint Louverture, becoming commander at Cap-Français and brigadier general by 1801. When Leclerc's expedition arrived in February 1802 he burned Cap-Français as ordered, submitted in April and rejoined Dessalines in October. After Dessalines' assassination he was elected president of the State of Haiti in February 1807 and in March 1811 proclaimed a kingdom, reigning as Henry I. He built the Citadelle Laferrière and the Sans-Souci Palace and drew sugar revenues from corvée labour, but lost popular support, and on 8 October 1820, ill and fearing a coup, he shot himself.

evidence.excerpt: Born Christophe Henry, probably in Grenada but perhaps Saint Kitts the son of a slave mother and Christophe, a freeman, he was brought as a slave to the northern part of Saint-Domingue.

Christophe carried out his orders, setting light to the town and slitting the throats of part of the white population.
In October, the former rebel leaders Alexander Petion, Henri Christophe and Jean-Jacques Dessalines all deserted the French forces as well.

bio.ko: 1770년 포르토프랭스에서 프랑스인 아버지와 자유 물라토 어머니 사이에서 태어나 1788년 파리 사관학교로 유학했다. 돌아와 영국군과 싸웠고 1796년 레오간에서 포격으로 영국군을 물리쳤다. 1799년 남부 전쟁에서 리고 편에 서서 자크멜을 지켰고 1800년 프랑스로 망명했다. 1802년 르클레르 원정군과 함께 돌아왔으나 투생이 추방된 뒤 10월 아르카에 비밀 회합에서 데살린을 지지해 반란군에 합류했다. 데살린 암살 음모에 가담했고 1807년 남부 아이티 공화국 대통령으로 선출되어 1816년 종신 대통령이 되었다. 대농장을 몰수해 농민에게 나누어 「파파 봉쾨르」라 불렸고, 1815년 볼리바르에게 피난처와 병력을 제공했으며 1818년 황열병으로 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in Port-au-Prince in 1770 to a French father and a free mulatto mother, he was sent to the Military Academy in Paris in 1788. Returning to fight the British, he drove them off at Léogâne with his guns in 1796. In the War of the South of 1799 he sided with Rigaud, commanded the defence of Jacmel and went into exile in France in 1800. He returned with Leclerc's expedition in 1802, but after Toussaint's deportation backed Dessalines at the secret conference of Arcahaie in October and joined the rebels. He took part in the conspiracy against Dessalines, was elected president of the southern Republic of Haiti in 1807 and made himself president for life in 1816. He redistributed the plantations to the peasantry, earning the name Papa Bon-Cœur, gave Bolívar sanctuary and troops in 1815 and died of yellow fever in 1818.

evidence.excerpt: Pétion was born "Anne Alexandre Sabès" in Port-au-Prince to Pascal Sabès, a wealthy French father and Ursula, a free mulatto woman

evidence.excerpt: By November, Rigaud's forces were pushed back to the strategic southern port of Jacmel by Louverture's army; the defence was commanded by Pétion. The town fell in March 1800 and the conflict was effectively over.
Petion, Boyer, and Rigaud returned with him in the hope of securing power in the colony.

evidence.excerpt: Pétion joined the rebels in October 1802. This followed a secret conference at Arcahaie, where Pétion supported Jean-Jacques Dessalines, the general who had captured Jacmel.
On 18 November 1803, black and mulatto forces under Dessalines and Pétion attacked the fort of Vertières, held by Rochambeau, near Cap-Français in the north.
Disaffected members of Emperor Dessalines's administration, including Pétion and Henri Christophe, began a conspiracy to overthrow Dessalines.

evidence.claim: president of the Republic of Haiti from 1807, for life from 1816
evidence.excerpt: On 2 June 1816, Pétion modified the terms of the presidency in the constitution, making himself president for life.
Pétion seized commercial plantations from the rich gentry. He had the land redistributed to his supporters and the peasantry, earning him the nickname Papa Bon-Cœur ("good-hearted father").
He gave sanctuary to the independence leader Simón Bolívar in 1815 and provided him with material and infantry support.
The official record states that he succumbed to yellow fever, a disease endemic to the Caribbean that claimed many lives during that era.

bio.ko: 1761년 레카이에서 부유한 프랑스인 농장주 아버지와 노예 어머니 사이에서 태어나 보르도에서 금세공을 배웠다. 돌아와 오제와 레몽의 뒤를 이어 자유 유색인의 권리를 대변했고, 1790년대 중반 서부·남부에서 군대를 이끌어 폴브렐로부터 통치권을 받았으며 1794년 레오간을 되찾고 티뷔롱을 탈환해 영국군을 막았다. 남부의 권력을 투생 루베르튀르에게 내주려 하지 않았고 에두빌의 부추김 속에 1799년 6월 남부 전쟁이 터졌다. 패한 뒤 1800년 프랑스로 떠났고, 1802년 르클레르 원정군과 함께 돌아왔다가 추방되어 투생과 같은 주 요새에 갇혔다. 1810년 12월 세 번째로 아이티에 돌아와 페티옹과 크리스토프 모두에 맞서 남부국의 대통령이 되었으나 1811년 9월 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in Les Cayes in 1761 to a wealthy French planter and an enslaved mother, he was trained as a goldsmith in Bordeaux. Back in the colony he succeeded Ogé and Raimond as the champion of the free people of colour, led an army in the West and South from the mid-1790s with authority granted by Polverel, and checked the British, retaking Léogâne and Tiburon in 1794. Unwilling to concede power in the South to Toussaint Louverture, and encouraged by Hédouville, he fought the War of the South from June 1799. After his defeat he left for France in 1800, returned with Leclerc's expedition in 1802 and was deported again, held in the Fort de Joux like Toussaint. In December 1810 he returned to Haiti a third time and made himself president of the State of the South against both Pétion and Christophe, but died in September 1811.

bio.ko: 1772년 퐁투아즈에서 태어나 1791년 입대했고 1793년 툴롱 포위전에서 나폴레옹을 처음 만났다. 이탈리아 원정에서 1797년 여단장이 되었고 그해 나폴레옹의 여동생 폴린과 결혼했으며, 브뤼메르 18일 쿠데타에서 척탄병을 이끌고 오백인회에 들어갔다. 1801년 말 투생 루베르튀르의 정부를 무너뜨리고 흑인 장교들을 추방하라는 지시를 받고 원정군 사령관이 되어 12월 14일 브레스트를 떠났다. 1802년 투생을 회담 자리에서 체포해 프랑스로 보냈으나, 과들루프의 노예제 복원 소식에 흑인 부대가 이탈하자 10월 나폴레옹에게 섬멸전을 건의했고 카프프랑세에서 흑인 병사 1,000명을 익사시켰다. 1802년 11월 황열병으로 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in Pontoise in 1772, he volunteered in 1791 and met Napoleon at the siege of Toulon in 1793. He became a brigade general in Italy in 1797, married Napoleon's sister Pauline that year and led grenadiers into the Council of Five Hundred in the coup of 18 Brumaire. In late 1801 he was given command of the expedition to Saint-Domingue with instructions to liquidate Toussaint Louverture's government and deport his officers, and sailed from Brest on 14 December. In 1802 he arrested Toussaint at a meeting and shipped him to France, but when news of the restoration of slavery in Guadeloupe set off desertions he proposed a war of annihilation to Napoleon in October and had 1,000 Black soldiers drowned at Cap-Français. He died of yellow fever in November 1802.

bio.ko: 1767년 무렵 세네감비아의 무슬림 집안에서 태어나 자메이카에서 노예가 되었고, 뒤에 생도맹그로 팔려 와 보두 사제가 되었다고 전해진다. 다른 노예에게 글을 가르치려다 팔려 농장 감독과 마부로 일했고, 이름은 영어 별명 「북맨」에서 왔다. 1791년 8월 14일 무렵 부아 카이망에서 여사제 세실 파티망과 함께 봉기를 준비하는 마지막 모임을 주재했고, 8월 22일 노에 제당소를 불태워 봉기를 열었다. 약 1만 5천 명의 반란군을 이끌고 카프프랑세로 향했으나 11월 7일 퐁블뢰에서 프랑스군에게 죽었고, 잘린 머리는 「반란군의 우두머리 부크만의 머리」라는 글귀와 함께 전시되었다.
bio.en: Born around 1767 to a Muslim family in Senegambia, he was captured and enslaved in Jamaica, then sold to Saint-Domingue, where he is said to have become a Vodou priest. Sold on after trying to teach other slaves to read, he worked as a slave driver and coach driver, and his name came from his English nickname "Book Man". On or about 14 August 1791 at Bois Caïman on the Choiseul plantation he presided, with the priestess Cécile Fatiman, over the last of the meetings that planned the rising, and on 22 August he gathered the slaves of the Dutilh, Héron and Noé estates and burned the Noé sugar works, opening the revolt. He led a rebel force that grew to around fifteen thousand towards Cap-Français, but on 7 November 1791 he was killed by French troops while defending the rebel base at Fond Bleu, and his head was displayed with the inscription "The head of Boukman, leader of the rebels".

bio.ko: 1757년 무렵 생도맹그 동동의 자유 유색인 농장주 가문에서 태어나 보르도에서 금세공을 배웠고, 1775년 돌아와 카프프랑세에서 아프리카계 가운데 가장 부유한 커피 상인이 되었다. 1788년 파리에 가서 혁명에 가담했고, 쥘리앵 레몽과 함께 자유 유색인의 대표권과 투표권을 국민제헌의회에 요구하면서도 노예 소유자로서 노예제의 존속은 지지했다. 1790년 3월 제헌의회가 모호한 투표권 법을 통과시키자 10월 몰래 돌아왔고, 식민 당국이 시행을 거부하자 샤반과 함께 약 300명을 모아 봉기했다. 패해 스페인령으로 달아났다가 붙잡혀 넘겨졌고, 1791년 2월 6일 카프프랑세에서 거열형으로 처형되었다. 그의 처형은 뒤에 노예 반란군의 저항 명분으로 거론되었다.
bio.en: Born around 1757 at Dondon to a free coloured planter family, he was apprenticed to a goldsmith in Bordeaux and returned in 1775 to become the richest merchant of African descent in Cap-Français. He went to Paris in 1788, joined the revolutionaries and with Julien Raimond demanded representation and voting rights for free people of colour from the National Constituent Assembly, while as a slaveholder supporting the continuation of slavery. After the Assembly passed an ambiguously worded law in March 1790 he returned secretly in October, and when the colonial authorities refused to implement it he and Chavannes gathered about 300 men and rose. Defeated, he fled to Spanish territory, was captured and handed over, and on 6 February 1791 was broken on the wheel at Cap-Français. His execution was later cited by the slave rebels as a reason to keep resisting.

bio.ko: 1756년 에브뢰에서 태어나 1789년부터 혁명을 지지해 아비롱 시장을 지내고 국유재산을 사들였다. 1792년 외르 의용대대 장교로 북부 전선에 나갔고, 1793년 방데에서 두 달 싸운 뒤 동피레네군을 지휘했다. 1793년 12월 30일 서부군 총사령관이 되어 1794년 1월 열두 개 종대에 반란에 가담한 「도적」을 여자와 아이까지 죽이고 마을을 불태우라고 지시했다. 지옥 종대는 넉 달 동안 민간인 2만~5만 명을 죽였으나 봉기를 되살렸고, 그는 5월 해임되고 9월 체포되었다. 1795년 12월 군사재판은 명령을 따랐을 뿐이라며 무죄를 선고했고, 그는 1803~1811년 주미 대사와 1812년 제국 남작으로 출세한 뒤 1816년 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in Évreux in 1756, he backed the Revolution from 1789, served as mayor of Aviron and bought confiscated church property. An officer of the Eure volunteers on the northern frontier in 1792, he fought two months in the Vendée in 1793 and then commanded the Army of the Eastern Pyrenees. Taking command of the Army of the West on 30 December 1793, in January 1794 he ordered twelve columns to bayonet the “brigands” who had joined the revolt, women and children included, and to burn the villages. In four months these infernal columns killed 20,000 to 50,000 civilians but revived the rising; he was recalled in May 1794 and arrested in September. A military tribunal acquitted him in December 1795 because he had only obeyed orders, and he prospered as ambassador to the United States from 1803 to 1811 and a baron of the Empire in 1812, dying unprosecuted in 1816.

bio.ko: 1756년 오리야크 근처 욜레의 소작농 집안에서 태어나 소송대리인이 되었고, 혁명이 일어나자 국민방위대와 자코뱅 클럽에 들어갔다. 1792년 캉탈 선출 국민공회 의원으로 코르들리에와 자코뱅의 연설가였고 루이 16세 처형에 찬성했으며 지롱드파 축출에 가담했다. 1793년 가을 낭트에 파견되어 갈레른 행군에서 잡힌 포로가 쌓이자 12월부터 1794년 2월까지 바닥에 구멍을 낸 배로 루아르강에 가라앉히는 익사형과 집단 총살로 감옥을 비웠다. 그가 「수직 유배」라 부른 익사형으로 1,800~4,800명, 총살로 2,600명이 죽었다. 1794년 2월 소환된 뒤 튀로의 방침을 옹호했고 테르미도르에 가담했으나 낭트 혁명위원회 재판에서 기소되어 12월 16일 단두대에 올랐다.
bio.en: Born in 1756 at Yolet near Aurillac into a tenant-farming family, he became a procurator and, when the Revolution came, joined the National Guard and the Jacobin Club. Elected to the Convention for Cantal in 1792, an orator of the Cordeliers and Jacobins, he voted for the execution of Louis XVI and took part in the fall of the Girondins. Sent to Nantes in the autumn of 1793, where prisoners from the Virée de Galerne were piling up, from December 1793 to February 1794 he emptied the prisons by mass shootings and by drownings in the Loire on barges with trap-door bottoms. The drownings, which he called “vertical deportation”, killed 1,800 to 4,800 people and the shootings 2,600. Recalled in February 1794, he defended Turreau’s methods and joined the overthrow of Robespierre, but the trial of the Nantes revolutionary committee turned on him and he was guillotined on 16 December 1794.

bio.ko: 1753년 스트라스부르의 석공 집안에서 태어나 건축을 공부했고, 신성 로마 제국군 장교로 7년을 복무하다 평민 출신이라 승진이 막히자 돌아와 벨포르의 공공건물 감독관이 되었다. 1792년 오랭 의용대대에 들어가 1793년 마인츠 방어로 이름을 얻었고, 여단장으로 마인츠군과 함께 방데에 파견되었다. 토르푸에서 패했으나 10월 숄레의 승리에 기여해 사단장이 되었고, 마르소와 함께 12월 르망과 사부네에서 가톨릭 왕당군을 섬멸했다. 1794년 1월 튀로에게 주민의 신뢰를 얻고 반군 집결지만 치자는 안을 냈다가 거부당했고, 방데인에게 관대해야 한다고 말해 소환되었다. 뒤에 플뢰뤼스와 라인 전선에서 싸웠고 이집트 원정군을 지휘하다 1800년 카이로에서 암살되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1753 in Strasbourg, the son of a master builder, he studied architecture, served seven years as an officer of the Holy Roman Emperor and returned as inspector of public buildings at Belfort. He enlisted in the Haut-Rhin volunteers in 1792, won renown in the defence of Mainz in 1793 and was sent as a brigade general with the Army of Mainz to the Vendée. Beaten at Torfou, he contributed to the victory at Cholet in October, was promoted divisional general and, with Marceau, destroyed the Catholic and Royal Army at Le Mans and Savenay in December. In January 1794 Turreau rejected his plan to win the inhabitants’ trust and attack only rebel gatherings, and his opinion that the Vendéans deserved lenient measures got him recalled. He later fought at Fleurus and on the Rhine, commanded the army in Egypt and was assassinated in Cairo on 14 June 1800.

Finding that his humble birth hindered his chances for promotion beyond that of an unterleutnant, he left the Austrian army in 1783 after serving seven years.

Although beaten at the Battle of Tiffauges on 19 September 1793, he maintained good relations with the representatives on mission and managed to keep his command. A month later, Kléber contributed to the Republican victory at Cholet, earning him his promotion to divisional general on 17 October 1793.

Although he had only 10,000 men against 60,000 Turks, Kléber's forces utterly defeated the Ottomans on 20 March 1800.
The assassination happened in Cairo on 14 June 1800, coincidentally the same day on which Kléber's friend and comrade, Desaix, fell at Marengo.

bio.ko: 1768년 베르사유 근교에서 왕실 사냥터 마부의 아들로 태어나 1784년 근위연대 사병으로 입대했다. 1792년 장교가 되어 됭케르크 방어로 1793년 사단장과 모젤군 사령관에 올랐고 12월 알자스에서 오스트리아군을 몰아냈다. 1794년 3월 피슈그뤼의 고발로 체포되어 테르미도르 뒤에야 풀려났다. 서부의 연안군 사령관으로 1795년 2월 라자주네 조약으로 이어진 화해를 마무리했고, 7월 키브롱에서 영국이 실어 온 망명군을 섬멸했다. 12월 서부 전군을 지휘하게 되어 기동 종대와 사면, 예배의 자유로 1796년 스토플레와 샤레트를 잡아 방데 전쟁을 끝내고 슈앙의 항복을 받았다. 아일랜드 원정에 실패했고 1797년 잠시 전쟁장관을 지낸 뒤 29세로 병사했다.
bio.en: Born in 1768 near Versailles, a groom’s son, he enlisted as a private in the French Guards in 1784. Commissioned in 1792, he rose to divisional general and command of the Army of the Moselle in 1793 and drove the Austrians from Alsace. Arrested in March 1794 after a denunciation by Pichegru, he was freed only after Thermidor. Commanding the coastal armies in the west, he completed the conciliation that led to the Treaty of La Jaunaye in February 1795 and annihilated the émigré force landed by the British at Quiberon in July. Supreme commander in the west from December, he used disciplined mobile columns, amnesty and freedom of worship to capture Stofflet and Charette in 1796, ending the War in the Vendée, and took the surrender of the Chouans. His Irish expedition failed; he was briefly Minister of War in 1797 and died of tuberculosis aged 29.

bio.ko: 1751년 알자스 몰스하임에서 태어나 경기병으로 복무한 뒤 1790년 아그노 시 서기가 되었다. 1792년 파리에서 당통과 가까워졌고 8월 10일 튈르리궁 습격에서 연맹병 부대를 이끌었다. 뒤무리에의 참모로 종군하다 1793년 4월 그의 배반 뒤 체포되었으나 무죄를 입증하고 여단장이 되어 방데로 보내졌다. 라로셸 연안군 전위로 6월 파르트네와 7월 샤티용을 점령했으나 7월 5일 샤티용에서 대패해 정직되었다가 복직했다. 갈레른 행군 때 패배를 거듭했으나 르망과 사부네에서 왕당군 섬멸에 가담했고, 사부네 뒤 포로 500~700명을 총살했다. 「방데는 더 이상 없다」는 편지는 진위가 다투어진다. 1794년 당통의 벗으로 기소되어 4월 5일 당통파와 함께 처형되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1751 at Molsheim in Alsace, he served in a hussar regiment and in 1790 became clerk of Haguenau. In Paris from 1792 he became an ally of Danton and commanded fédérés in the attack on the Tuileries on 10 August. On Dumouriez’s staff, he was arrested after the general’s defection in April 1793, cleared and sent to the Vendée as a brigade general. Leading the vanguard of the Army of the Coasts of La Rochelle, he took Parthenay in June and Châtillon on 3 July, but was routed at Châtillon on 5 July and suspended. Beaten repeatedly in the Virée de Galerne, he took part in the destruction of the Catholic and Royal Army at Le Mans and Savenay, after which his hussars shot 500 to 700 prisoners. The letter attributed to him beginning “There is no more Vendée” is of disputed authenticity. Proscribed as a friend of Danton, he was guillotined with the Dantonists on 5 April 1794.

Westermann was born on 5 September 1751 in Molsheim, Alsace (today department of Bas-Rhin).
He enlisted in Count Esterhazy's regiment of hussars in 1767, retiring six years later as a non-commissioned officer. [...] in 1790 became greffier of the municipality of Haguenau.

Westermann moved to Paris in May 1792, where he became an ally of revolutionary leader Georges Danton. Westermann played a leading role in the insurrection of 10 August 1792, where he commanded a unit of fédérés in the attack on the Tuileries Palace.

After suffering a defeat at the First Battle of Châtillon, Westermann was suspended and brought before the National Convention, only recovering his command on 29 August.

Beaten at the battles of Croix-Bataille and Entrames, he defeated the Vendéens at Beaupréau, Granville, and in December 1793 annihilated the Catholic and Royal Army at the Battle of Le Mans and the Battle of Savenay.
Westermann and his hussards shot 500 to 700 prisoners, men, women, and children, at the Sem forest near Prinquiau.
In a controversial document, the authenticity of which is disputed, Westermann supposedly wrote to the Committee of Public Safety: "There is no more Vendée, Republican citizens.

bio.ko: 1752년 드레스덴에서 폴란드 왕의 고문이던 프랑스인 아버지에게서 태어나 1757년 프랑스에 귀화했다. 왕실 기병 장교로 복무하다 1783년 제대해 앙주의 보프레오에 은거했고, 1790년 연맹제에 멘에루아르 대표로 참석할 만큼 혁명에 호의적이었다. 1793년 3월 징집에 맞서 봉기한 농민들이 군 경험을 보고 그를 지휘관으로 끌어냈다. 4월 슈미예에서 포로 학살을 요구하는 부하들에게 주기도문을 외우게 하고 「하느님께 거짓말하지 말라」며 포로를 살렸다. 카틀리노가 죽자 7월 19일 총사령관으로 뽑혔으나 뤼송에서 두 번 패했고, 10월 숄레에서 중상을 입어 누아르무티에섬으로 옮겨졌다. 1794년 1월 3일 섬을 점령한 공화국군에 붙잡혀 안락의자에 앉은 채 총살되었다.
bio.en: Born in 1752 in Dresden to a French father who was a privy councillor of the King of Poland, he was naturalised French in 1757. An officer of royal cavalry, he resigned in 1783 and retired to Beaupréau in Anjou, and represented Maine-et-Loire at the Fête de la Fédération in 1790. In March 1793 the peasants who had risen against conscription forced him to lead them because of his military experience. At Chemillé in April he saved the Republican prisoners his men wanted to kill by making them recite the Lord’s Prayer and breaking in with “Do not lie to God”. Elected generalissimo on 19 July 1793 after Cathelineau’s death, he was twice beaten at Luçon and gravely wounded at Cholet in October, and was carried to the island of Noirmoutier. Captured when Republican troops took the island on 3 January 1794, unable to stand, he was shot in an armchair. His wife was shot on 29 January.

bio.en: Born in 1753 at Bathelémont in Lorraine, a miller’s son, he served for long as a private in a Swiss regiment and later became a gamekeeper at Maulévrier. Chosen as a leader for his military past when Anjou rose in March 1793, he took Saint-Florent-le-Vieil with Cathelineau and fought under d’Elbée at Fontenay, Cholet, Laval and Antrain. Appointed major-general of the royalist army, he took command after La Rochejaquelein was killed in January 1794 and, with peasants fleeing the infernal columns, briefly retook Cholet on 8 February. At La Jaunaye in February 1795 he refused to recognise the Republic, but Canclaux’s offensive drove him to make peace on the same terms at Saint-Florent-le-Vieil on 2 May. On the orders of the Count of Artois he rose again in January 1796, was surprised in a farmhouse near La Poitevinière, condemned by a military commission at Angers and shot on 25 February.

bio.ko: 쇤하우젠의 융커 집안에서 태어나 프랑크푸르트 연방의회 대표와 러시아·프랑스 대사를 지냈고, 1862년 빌헬름 1세가 군제 개혁 예산을 둘러싼 의회와의 충돌을 뚫기 위해 그를 총리로 임명했다. 1890년까지 프로이센 총리 겸 외무장관으로 덴마크·오스트리아·프랑스와의 세 차례 전쟁을 이끌었고, 1866년 북독일연방을 세웠으며 1870년 엠스 전보를 손질해 공개해 프랑스의 선전포고를 끌어냈다. 1871년 베르사유에서 빌헬름 1세를 황제로 선포하고 제국의 첫 재상이 되었다. 문화투쟁으로 가톨릭과 싸우고 1878년 반사회주의자법으로 사회민주당을 억눌렀으며, 동맹 체계로 프랑스를 고립시켰다. 1890년 빌헬름 2세의 요구로 사임해 1898년 프리드리히스루에서 죽었다.
bio.en: Born into a Junker family at Schönhausen, he was Prussia's envoy to the Frankfurt Diet and ambassador to Russia and France before Wilhelm I made him minister president in 1862 to force the army reforms through the Landtag. Minister president and foreign minister until 1890, he led three short wars against Denmark, Austria and France, founded the North German Confederation in 1866 and in 1870 published the edited Ems dispatch that drew France into declaring war. In 1871 he had Wilhelm I proclaimed emperor at Versailles and became the empire's first chancellor. He fought the Catholic Church in the Kulturkampf, suppressed the Social Democrats with the Anti-Socialist Law of 1878 and introduced social insurance to undercut them, while his alliances isolated France. Dismissed at Wilhelm II's insistence in 1890, he died at Friedrichsruh in 1898.

Under Bismarck's leadership, Prussia provoked three short, decisive wars against Denmark, Austria, and France.
After Austria's defeat in 1866, he replaced the German Confederation with the North German Confederation, which aligned the smaller North German states with Prussia while excluding Austria.

To provoke France into declaring war with Prussia, Bismarck published the Ems Dispatch, a carefully edited version of a conversation between King Wilhelm and the French ambassador to Prussia, Count Benedetti.
While the war was in its final phase, Wilhelm I of Prussia was proclaimed German Emperor on 18 January 1871 in the Hall of Mirrors in the Château de Versailles.

In 1871, Bismarck was raised to the rank of Fürst (Prince). He was also appointed as the first Imperial Chancellor (Reichskanzler) of the German Empire but retained his Prussian offices, including those of Minister-President and Foreign Minister.
Bismarck launched an anti-Catholic Kulturkampf ("culture struggle") in Prussia in 1871.

bio.ko: 나폴레옹 1세의 조카로 파리에서 태어나 7월 왕정에 맞선 두 차례 쿠데타에 실패하고 1840년 투옥되었다. 1848년 제2공화국 대통령에 뽑혔고, 재선이 막히자 1851년 12월 2일 쿠데타로 권력을 잡아 1852년 황제가 되었다. 제2제정은 철도와 파리 개조의 시대였으나 1866년 이후 프로이센의 부상에 밀렸다. 1870년 5월 국민투표에서 이긴 뒤 7월 여론에 떠밀려 프로이센에 선전포고했고, 병든 몸으로 군을 따라갔다가 9월 2일 스당에서 포로가 되었다. 빌헬름스회에에 억류된 동안 파리에서 공화국이 선포되었고 1871년 3월 국민의회가 그의 폐위를 선언했다. 풀려난 뒤 영국 치즐허스트로 망명해 1873년 죽었다.
bio.en: A nephew of Napoleon I, born in Paris, he led two failed coups against the July Monarchy and was imprisoned in 1840. Elected president of the Second Republic in 1848, he seized power by the coup of 2 December 1851 when he could not be re-elected and became emperor in 1852. The Second Empire was an age of railways and the rebuilding of Paris, but after 1866 it was overshadowed by Prussia. Having won the plebiscite of May 1870, in July he declared war on Prussia under public pressure, accompanied the army though seriously ill and was taken prisoner at Sedan on 2 September. While he was held at Wilhelmshöhe a republic was proclaimed in Paris, and in March 1871 the National Assembly declared him deposed. Released, he went into exile at Chislehurst in England and died there in 1873.

bio.ko: 프리드리히 빌헬름 3세의 둘째 아들로 태어나 나폴레옹 전쟁에 참전했고, 1848년 베를린 봉기를 대포로 진압해 「산탄 왕자」라 불렸다. 1858년 섭정, 1861년 국왕이 되었고 군제 개혁 예산을 둘러싸고 의회와 충돌하자 1862년 비스마르크를 총리로 임명했다. 1870년 7월 13일 바트엠스에서 프랑스 대사 베네데티의 요구를 거절했고, 그라블로트와 스당에서 독일군을 총지휘했다. 「독일의 황제」 칭호를 원했으나 비스마르크의 설득으로 「독일 황제」를 받아들여 1871년 1월 18일 베르사유에서 선포되었다. 통치는 대체로 비스마르크에게 맡겼고 1878년의 암살 시도는 반사회주의자법의 구실이 되었다. 1888년 90세로 죽었다.
bio.en: The second son of Frederick William III, born in Berlin, he fought in the Napoleonic Wars and in 1848 crushed the Berlin rising with cannon, earning the nickname "Prince of Grapeshot". Regent from 1858 and king from 1861, he appointed Bismarck minister president in 1862 when the Landtag refused the military budget, and was commander-in-chief in the wars against Denmark in 1864 and Austria in 1866. On 13 July 1870 at Bad Ems he refused the demand of the French ambassador Benedetti, and he commanded the German forces at Gravelotte and Sedan. He wanted the title "Emperor of Germany" but, persuaded by Bismarck, accepted "German Emperor" and was proclaimed at Versailles on 18 January 1871. He left governing largely to Bismarck; the assassination attempts of 1878 became the pretext for the Anti-Socialist Laws. He died in 1888 at the age of 90.

During the Revolutions of 1848, Wilhelm successfully crushed a revolt in Berlin that was aimed at Frederick William IV. The use of cannons made him unpopular at the time and earned him the nickname Kartätschenprinz (Prince of Grapeshot).
In January 1858, Wilhelm became Prince Regent for his brother, initially only temporarily but after October on a permanent basis.
On 2 January 1861, Frederick William IV died and Wilhelm ascended the throne as Wilhelm I of Prussia.
Then, on the advice of Roon, Wilhelm appointed Otto von Bismarck as Minister President in order to force through the proposals.
During his reign, Wilhelm was the commander-in-chief of the Prussian forces in the Second Schleswig War against Denmark in 1864 and the Austro-Prussian War in 1866.
In 1870, during the Franco-Prussian War, Wilhelm was in command of all the German forces at the crucial Battle of Sedan, as well as at the Battle of Gravelotte.
Wilhelm eventually—though grudgingly—relented and on 18 January, he was formally proclaimed as emperor in the Hall of Mirrors in the Palace of Versailles.
Despite possessing considerable power as Kaiser, Wilhelm left the task of governing mostly to his chancellor, limiting himself to representing the state and approving Bismarck's every policy.

bio.en: Born at Parchim in Mecklenburg, the son of a German general in Danish service, he was educated at the Copenhagen military academy and became a Prussian second lieutenant in 1822. Chief of the General Staff from 1857, he held the post for thirty years and created a new way of directing armies that used railways and the telegraph. Chief of staff of the allied forces against Denmark in 1864 and director of the Königgrätz campaign of 1866, he was appointed chief of staff for the war in July 1870 with the right to issue orders equivalent to royal commands. By wheeling three armies he shut Bazaine in Metz, encircled MacMahon at Sedan and then besieged Paris. Made a count in 1870 and a field marshal in 1871, he sat in the Reichstag for the Conservative Party from 1867. He retired in 1888 and died in Berlin in 1891; his is the only surviving voice recording of a person born in 1800.

bio.en: Born at Cahors, the son of a Genoese grocer, he was called to the bar in 1859 and made his name in 1868 defending Delescluze with an attack on the coup of 1851. Elected in 1869, he became the leading defender of the lower classes against the Empire. He opposed the declaration of war in 1870 but voted funds for the army, proclaimed the Republic at the Hôtel de Ville on 4 September and became interior minister of the Government of National Defence. On 7 October he left Paris by balloon and at Tours, as minister of the interior and of war, raised new armies in the provinces; opposing the armistice, he resigned on 6 February 1871. He led the republicans through the constitutional laws of 1875 and the crisis of 16 May 1877, telling MacMahon to "submit or resign", was president of the Chamber from 1879 and prime minister for 66 days in 1881–82, and died of cancer in 1882.

bio.ko: 브르타뉴 벨일에서 태어나 생시르를 나왔고, 알제리에서 뷔조 원수의 부관, 크림 전쟁에서 여단장으로 복무했다. 1867년 오를레앙파 색채의 『1867년의 프랑스군』을 익명으로 펴내 궁정의 미움을 샀고 개전 때 야전 지휘를 받지 못했다. 초기 패전 뒤 1870년 8월 17일 파리 총독 겸 수도 방위군 총사령관이 되었고, 9월 4일 혁명으로 국방정부의 수반이 되었다. 「파리 총독은 결코 항복하지 않는다」는 포고와 달리 여론에 밀린 출격은 모두 실패했고, 1871년 1월 22일 총독직을 비누아에게 넘기고 휴전 뒤까지 정부 수반직만 유지했다. 국민의회 모르비앙 의원을 지낸 뒤 1872년 정계, 1873년 군에서 물러났고 1896년 투르에서 죽었다.
bio.en: Born on Belle-Île in Brittany and trained at Saint-Cyr, he served in Algeria as aide-de-camp to Marshal Bugeaud and in the Crimea as a brigade commander. In 1867 he published anonymously L'Armée française en 1867, a work of Orleanist sentiment that offended the court, and he was refused a field command at the outbreak of war. After the early defeats he became governor of Paris and commander-in-chief of its defence on 17 August 1870, and the revolution of 4 September made him president of the Government of National Defence. He proclaimed that the governor of Paris would never capitulate, yet the sorties made under pressure of public opinion all failed; on 22 January 1871 he handed the governorship to Vinoy, keeping the presidency until after the armistice. Deputy for Morbihan, he retired from politics in 1872 and the army in 1873, and died at Tours in 1896.

bio.ko: 리옹에서 태어나 변호사가 되었고 1830년 혁명 때부터 공화파를 자처했다. 1851년 쿠데타 때 위고 등과 무장 저항을 조직하려 했다. 1858년 파리에서 당선되어 제정에 맞선 공화파 「5인」의 하나가 되었다. 1870년 티에르와 함께 전쟁에 반대했고 스당 뒤 황제의 폐위를 요구했다. 국방정부 부수반 겸 외무장관으로 9월 6일 「영토의 한 치도, 요새의 돌 하나도」 내주지 않겠다고 선언했으나 페리에르에서 비스마르크의 알자스-로렌 요구를 들었다. 1871년 1월 28일 휴전을 맺고 동부군이 제외된 것을 알리지 않아 그 군대는 스위스로 넘어가야 했다. 프랑크푸르트 조약 뒤 1871년 8월 물러났고, 1876년 상원의원이 되어 1880년 죽었다.
bio.en: Born in Lyon, he became a lawyer and declared himself a republican from 1830. He tried with Victor Hugo to resist the coup of 1851 and was elected for Paris in 1858 as one of the republican "Five" opposing the Empire. With Thiers he opposed the war of 1870, and after Sedan demanded the emperor's deposition. As vice-president and foreign minister of the Government of National Defence he declared on 6 September that France would not yield "an inch of territory nor a single stone of the fortresses", only to hear Bismarck's demand for Alsace-Lorraine at Ferrières. He arranged the armistice of 28 January 1871 without knowing the state of the armies and failed to report that the Army of the East was excluded, so that it had to retreat into Switzerland. Discredited after the Treaty of Frankfurt, he withdrew in August 1871, became a senator in 1876 and died in 1880.

bio.en: Born in Vienna a German prince of the House of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha-Koháry, he was an officer in the Austro-Hungarian army when the Grand National Assembly elected him Prince of Bulgaria in 1887; in 1908 he proclaimed independence and took the title of tsar. In 1912 he declared the war on the Ottoman Empire "a just, great and sacred struggle of the Cross against the Crescent", and in June 1913 General Savov, under his direct orders and without consulting the government, launched the attack on Serbia and Greece. The Treaty of Bucharest cost Bulgaria most of Macedonia. He took Bulgaria into the First World War on the side of the Central Powers, abdicated in favour of his son Boris III in October 1918 and died in exile in Coburg in 1948.

Called to Athens after the Military League coup of 1909, he became prime minister in 1910 and pushed through the 1911 constitution and the reorganisation of the army and navy. In 1912 he brought Greece into the Balkan League, and he pressed Crown Prince Constantine to take Thessaloniki "à tout prix" before the Bulgarians. In 1913 he concluded the alliance with Serbia and led the Greek delegation at the Bucharest peace talks. His clash with King Constantine over entering the First World War produced the National Schism. Sentenced to death in absentia after a failed coup in 1935, he died in exile in Paris in 1936.

bio.en: Born in Zaječar, he studied engineering in Zürich, where he joined Svetozar Marković's circle of socialist and radical students, and went on to lead the People's Radical Party. Sentenced to death after the Timok Rebellion, he escaped into exile in Bulgaria. He was prime minister of Serbia several times from 1904, and after forming a new cabinet in September 1912 led the country through the Balkan League and both Balkan Wars, heading the Serbian delegation at Bucharest. During the First World War he led the government in exile on Corfu, and after 1918 served as prime minister of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes until shortly before his death in Belgrade in 1926.

Prime minister from 29 March 1911, he pursued the policy of the Balkan League and led Bulgaria through the First Balkan War, but resigned on 30 May 1913, the day the Treaty of London was signed, because he opposed the tsar's policy of making war on the allies.

bio.ko: 1860년 몬테네그로 공이 되었고 1910년 첫 국왕이 되었다. 1912년 발칸 전쟁이 터지자 동맹국 가운데 가장 열성적으로 오스만 제국을 유럽에서 몰아내려 했고, 10월 8일 맨 먼저 선전포고했다. 열강이 몬테네그로 해안 전체를 봉쇄했는데도 포위전 끝에 1913년 4월 슈코드라를 차지했으나, 알바니아 독립을 앞세운 열강의 압력으로 내놓아야 했다. 1916년 오스트리아-헝가리에 나라를 점령당해 이탈리아와 프랑스로 망명했고, 1918년 폐위된 뒤에도 왕위를 주장하다 1921년 앙티브에서 죽었다.
bio.en: Prince of Montenegro from 1860 and its first and only king from 1910. When the Balkan Wars broke out in 1912 he was the most enthusiastic of the allies, eager to drive the Ottomans out of Europe, and on 8 October Montenegro was the first to declare war. Defying the Concert of Europe, which blockaded the whole Montenegrin coast, he took Scutari after a siege in April 1913, but the Great Powers, set on an independent Albania, made him give it up. Montenegro was overrun by Austria-Hungary in 1916 and he fled to Italy and France; deposed in 1918, he went on claiming the throne until his death at Antibes in 1921.

bio.en: Born in Vlorë to an Albanian noble family, he studied law in Istanbul and served in the Ottoman administration. Driven into exile by Abdul Hamid II in 1900, he returned after the Young Turk Revolution as deputy for Berat in the Ottoman parliament. He played a major part in the Albanian revolt of 1912, and when the Balkan allies moved to partition Albanian lands he secured Austro-Hungarian backing in Vienna and went to Vlorë, where he led the declaration of independence on 28 November 1912. He headed the provisional government as prime minister and foreign minister until resigning in January 1914, and died in exile at Perugia in Italy in 1919.

bio.ko: 우지체에서 태어나 빵집과 기계 공장 노동자, 면사무소 서기로 일하며 독학으로 사회주의를 익혔다. 스베토자르 마르코비치의 영향을 받아 카우츠키의 노선을 따랐고, 1903년 디미트리예 투초비치와 함께 세르비아 사회민주당을 세웠다. 1905~1908년과 1912~1919년 의회 의원으로 발칸 전쟁과 1차 세계대전 직전 전쟁 예산에 반대표를 던지고 발칸 연방을 주장했다. 당 안에서는 투초비치의 좌파와 논쟁하며 중도적 입장에 섰다. 1919년 이후 볼셰비키와 코민테른 가입에 반대해 1920년 유고슬라비아 공산당에서 제명되었고, 개량주의 사회당을 만든 뒤 정치에서 물러나 노동운동사를 썼다.
bio.en: Born in Užice, he worked in a bakery and a mechanic shop and as a municipal clerk while teaching himself socialism. Influenced by Svetozar Marković, he followed Kautsky, and in 1903 founded the Serbian Social Democratic Party with Dimitrije Tucović. As a deputy in the Skupština in 1905–1908 and 1912–1919 he voted against war budgets before the Balkan Wars and the First World War and advocated a Balkan federation. Inside the party he took centrist positions against Tucović's left wing. After 1919 he opposed the Bolsheviks and affiliation to the Comintern, was expelled from the Yugoslav communist party in 1920, founded a reformist Socialist Party and then left politics to write the history of the Serbian labour movement.
